definitions: A long, hollow cylinder of metal, plastic, glass, etc., used for conveying or holding liquids or gases, or for structural purposes.
A collapsible metal or plastic cylinder sealed at one end and with a cap at the other, used for holding a semi-liquid substance such as toothpaste or paint.
A valved electronic device in which the flow of electrons between electrodes in an evacuated glass or metal enclosure can be controlled.
A hollow cylindrical part of the body, such as a Fallopian tube or a bronchial tube.
examples: I'm taking the Tube to work today.
The old radio used vacuum tubes.
The doctor examined her bronchial tubes.
